notes.title: Nock - Evolve
notes.content:
🏐 New game mode - Volleyball! Available for matchmaking or custom games it features a custom built arena, new rules, 1v1, 2v2 and 3v3 modes and a whole new game to master.

🏟️ New arena, Uberstadion! Experience the most exhilarating VR sport In front of 1000s of people in the grandest arena yet!

❄️ New winter themed main menu and social lobby!

🚽 Brand new wild and wacky items in the store!

🏪 Item store leaves beta testing and is publicly available to everyone in Airside Park.

🪙 Ball can now be bought in bulk, beat the queue to buy those beautiful blocks

🔢 Lifetime stats are now available in the main menu under the Training option. Check your W/L, shots and much more!

🪝Curved arrows have been introduced to Airside Park and Levels! Take your trick shots to the next level by holding your bow hand trigger and pointing your bow in the direction you want to curve!

🗓️ Daily log in bonuses now award the correct amounts!

 🐛 Bug fixes

[h1]Coming this January [/h1]

Season Pass: A brand new season pass will be landing in early January! Possibly our best one yet!

Holiday Announcement: I'm very excited to announce that later this month we will be sharing something big we have been working on that is sure to draw more players to Nock!

A huge thank you to everyone that has helped us beta test and hunt down bugs over the past few weeks, we could not have done this without you!

Stay tuned with us on Instagram, TikTok, and Twitter: @[url=https://twitter.com/nockgame]NockGame[/url]

🤍 The Normal Team

notes.title: The biggest nock season yet is here - Nightfall is out now
notes.content:
Nightfall Is Here!

We're thrilled to present the "Nock - Nightfall" update, packed with a bunch of new changes

⚽ New Casual Mode Rules - If you're ahead by 2 goals or more, your opponent's now getting a goalie block, turning up the heat. And if you find yourself up by 3 goals or more, you won't be getting your arrow back after hitting the ball. It's game-changing.

🌌 All New Menu Theme - A DARK RED NIGHT. The birds are here too.

🌆 Nightfall at Airside Park - The whole park transforms under the cloak of darkness.

🎁 New Season Track - Our refreshed season track now boasts 30+ new items. Now featuring a handful of animated blocks, bows, and skins for the first time ever.

🌟 Fresh Weekly Challenges - The new weekly challenge items are our best yet, with some seasonal bangers.

Share your thoughts and join the conversation on [url=http://www.nock.game/discord]Discord[/url]. Stay tuned with us on Instagram, TikTok, and Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/nockgame]@NockGame[/url]

Normal

notes.title: Nock - Levels, OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]https://nock.game/assets/tunnel1.png[/img]


We've taken Nock to the next level by introducing 45 thrilling obstacle courses spread across 5 circuits. This marks the most significant expansion to Nock to date. You can locate these new challenges via the doors right in the heart of the park. Go, go, go!

[h3]v1.10.0 - LEVELS[/h3]
LEVELS is a whole new way to play, transport yourself from the social lobby through one of 6 doorways to test your abilities, compete for the best times or highest scores in 4 brand new leaderboards!
- New GameMode LEVELS in the Social Lobby
- 5 Unique worlds to challenge
- Bonus Marathon run - how fast can you complete them all?
- Global and Weekly leaderboards - fastest time, least arrows, least falls, highest score.
- Change your loadout without leaving Airside Park
- Change your room code without leaving Airside Park
- Push To Talk and Mute All buttons in the pause menu are fixed
- Improvements to netcode

Normal Team

notes.title: Nock is launching this Thursday July 13th!
notes.content:
[img]https://nock.game/assets/steam.jpg[/img]

We are thrilled to announce the launch Nock on Steam this Thursday July 13th!
Our playtests with the community the past few weeks have been a blast and we couldn't have hit this launch without you guys.

This launch coincides with the start of our new season Airside Park, rolling out across all platforms. This has cosmetics as part of a season pass, a new social lobby, new menu theme, and new spectator camera options for PC players.

[b]BIG NEWS![/b]
All Steam players will get the "Companion Cube" block cosmetic from Portal which is exclusive to the Steam version of Nock. We are super excited about this one, probably our most favorite cosmetic to date.

[img]http://nock.game/assets/companion.png[/img]
Thank you so much for being a part of this journey with us! Can't wait to play with you all on Thursday.
- Normal

notes.title: PCVR Playtest June 30th - July 4th
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that another PCVR playtest session has been scheduled! Get geared up and ready to help us finalize Nock for PCVR.

📅 Mark your calendars: The playtest kicks off this Friday, June 30th at 10:30am ET, and will run through Tuesday, July 4th at 11:59pm ET. It's your chance to be among the first to experience Nock on PCVR, and contribute to its development.

🔥 We want to hear your thoughts, suggestions, and ideas to make our game the best it can be. Your insights will shape the direction of the game.

💬 Join our Discord community:  Engage with fellow players, developers, and passionate gamers like yourself. Share your experiences, exchange strategies, and provide feedback directly to the development team. 

[url=https://discord.gg/Kr6GqNgrYu]Discord[/url]

📝We created a feedback form to gather your input and ensure that we don't miss anything. Your constructive criticism, bug reports, and gameplay suggestions are super helpful! Please fill out this form after you have concluded your playtest session.

[url=https://forms.gle/QXDPR4s5E5iao1Pp9]Feedback Form[/url]

🙏 Thank you for your continued support and participation. Your enthusiasm fuels our passion, and we're honored to have you on this incredible journey with us.

We look forward to seeing you in the game, lets gooooooo 🎉

notes.title: Sign ups now available for the Nock public playtest
notes.content:
How's it going folks!

We've just updated the Nock store page so you can now request access to an upcoming playtest!
Once you are logged in, the playtest should be visible below "Coming Soon".

Some cool features you can expect from the PC version.
- Spectator camera with 4 modes for awesome streams and videos
- Seriously improved graphics with post-processing
- The smoothest experience yet, nock runs incredibly on PC

Some quick info: The playtest is not available to play right away but it is first-come first-served, so the earlier you register your interest you'll have a better chance at being among the first to play!

Keep an eye here as we will announce the dates very soon.

-- Normal Team
